completion_criteria.text: hooks/lib/pre-tool-use.mjs inverted to deny-by-default inside a protected root: any resolvable token under a protected root DENIES unless the segment head is on an explicit read-only allowlist. shell-tokens.mjs left unchanged.

Both directions proven by committed tests: all 12 verified evasions (including `( rm -rf <root> )` and `sudo rm -rf <root>`) assert DENY, and the 41-command read-only corpus asserts ALLOW. Red-before/green-after evidence recorded.
The scanSegments blow-up resolved so the guard fails CLOSED on oversized or pathological input, never open, with a test asserting the fail-closed path at the boundary.
Full plugin test suite green on the branch, and a fresh code-reviewer plus security-reviewer pass over the final diff returns no CRITICAL or HIGH findings.

Branch merged to main, plugin published to the marketplace, and re-installed globally - then a live end-to-end check against the real store shows a real evasion DENIED and ordinary read commands still ALLOWED.

spine.active_goal: Invert the PreToolUse Bash guard from allow-unless-provably-destructive to deny-by-default inside a protected root, so parse gaps in the frozen bash tokenizer stop being silent evasions. Design is DONE and user-approved (0018). Remaining: TDD the build, review, merge, publish, re-install.
spine.next_step: BUILD. Design locked in 0018 - do NOT re-litigate A-H. Read the spec at .claude/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-26-pre-tool-use-guard-deny-by-default-design.md (UNTRACKED) and follow its implementation order, one commit each: size cap; tokenizer tripwire; RED corpus with output captured first; allowlist tables; splitControl; the inversion. Repo continuity-ledger-plugin, branch fix/pre-tool-use-guard. Dispatch implementer/test-engineer.
open_risks: splitControl MUST carry the fd-dup exemption: an ampersand-digit word token after a redirect token is NOT a control char. Without it, `ls -la ROOT 2>&1 | head` breaks - asserted allowed at test/unit/hooks/pre-tool-use.test.mjs:139.

NEW, refutes 0011: inversion alone does NOT close backgrounding, it INTRODUCES the hole. A bare ampersand is an ordinary word char, so `ls ROOT & rm -rf ROOT` is ONE segment headed by ls. 0011 assumed grouping AND backgrounding closed; only grouping does.

Whole-command scoping is DISQUALIFIED, do not revisit: heredoc bodies tokenize as segments with arbitrary heads, so it denies every heredoc and resurrects the canonical false positive. Per-segment deny plus sink overlays O1/O2 adopted.

Five assertions need verdicts REWRITTEN not extended: pre-tool-use.test.mjs lines 28, 79, 80 to deny; 84 to ask; 85 to deny. Lines 62-63 (git -C ROOT show) must STAY allowed - that is what the operand-aware git resolver preserves.
The 12 and 41 corpus figures are FLOORS with no upstream provenance (0014). Assert them programmatically and report ACTUAL measured counts; never present 12/41 as findings.
MERGE BLOCK STANDS on fix/pre-tool-use-guard for the 0016 reason. Repo is currently checked out on that branch at 5f04dd4.

Criterion 3 tension resolved: cap input in pre-tool-use.mjs BEFORE scanSegments; shell-tokens.mjs stays frozen. Measured curve: 25.34 ms at 16 KB, 166 ms at 32 KB, 4.1 s at 128 KB. MAX_COMMAND_BYTES = 16384.

Silent allow-paths approved in the NARROW variant ONLY - a PreToolUse-only runGuardEntry. Do NOT make runEntry globally fail closed; all six hooks share it and the blast radius is session-breaking. The roots-length-zero bypass is DEFERRED.

UNAUTHORIZED DEFECT, do not fix without explicit go: the Stop hook nags every turn while any thread is active. stop.mjs:5-13 exits 2 unconditionally and never reads ctx.input (supplied at hook-io.mjs:28); the documented breaker is stop_hook_active, and it wants SessionEnd not Stop.
Parking the thread at paused is what lets stop.mjs:11 run `ledger-cli sync`, which this thread lists as out of scope. That is why the thread was kept active mid-session despite the nag.
The design spec is UNTRACKED in windful-ocean and exists only on disk. Commit it or it dies with the working tree.
Suite is 513 pass / 0 fail WHILE 21+ evasions exist. Green proves nothing until the corpora land.
Concurrent sessions write ONE store. Decision numbers are not contiguous; 0017 was taken by another session while this one wrote 0018.
